standard_prerequisites.name: Intersection with a regularly embedded subscheme and composition of Gysin maps
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Chow Homology, the lemmas identifying the intersection with a regularly embedded subscheme through the Gysin map, computing the Gysin map for flat morphisms, and composing Gysin maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Rewrites the intersection of the graph with a pulled back cycle in terms of the Gysin map along the graph.

standard_prerequisites.name: Composition of proper pushforwards
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Chow Homology, the lemma that proper pushforward is compatible with composition
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the pushforward along the projection composed with the graph with the identity pushforward.

core_obligations: Pushforward of cycles (proof lines 683-695): the pushforward by the correspondence of the graph is computed by intersecting the graph with the pullback of the cycle and pushing forward along the second projection; the intersection is rewritten through the Gysin map along the graph, whose composition with the projection is the Gysin map of the morphism itself, so the result is the Gysin pullback of the cycle.

Pullback of cycles (proof lines 697-703): the same computation with the roles of the two projections exchanged shows that pulling back a cycle by the correspondence is the pushforward of the cycle along the morphism.
The transpose (proof lines 705-715): the corresponding statements for the transpose correspondence are obtained by the same computation with the projections interchanged.
proof_roadmap: Compute the intersection defining the pushforward by the correspondence and rewrite it through Gysin maps.
Repeat with the projections exchanged for the pullback.
Obtain the transpose statements by the same computation.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the correspondence of the graph of a morphism acts on cycles by the Gysin pullback and the pushforward, and that the transpose correspondence acts in the opposite way (statement lines 660-681). The proof (proof lines 682-715) computes the defining intersection products through Gysin maps and composition of pushforwards. H2: a complete computation.
